identification: SAMAP Moulin a Cereales Manuel (French hand-cranked stone grain mill), made by SAMAP, Horbourg-Wihr, Colmar, France. White stone/cement-looking burr housing with steel crank arm and cream handle; mounted by bolts/screws; no hopper or clamp visible. Rusted crank, chipped paint, peeling label.
